homology_audit.method: EMBOSS needleall (EBLOSUM62, gapopen=10, gapextend=0.5), global alignment, every external-control sequence against every FR1 positive
homology_audit.conclusion: ZERO genuine homology hits (>=40% identity AND >=15 AA alignment length) found between the external control and any FR1 positive -- the only hits at/above the 40% threshold are short-fragment (<15 AA) chance matches, the same artifact already documented in Bucket 2.4. No fold-specific violation is possible given the global null result (any fold's held-out positives are a subset of the full 1,205 screened here).

biopep_uwm_reconciliation.status: DOCUMENTED, NOT EXCLUDED -- pending explicit policy confirmation
biopep_uwm_reconciliation.evidence: AnOxPePred reports both FRS and Chelator assays as inactive for these 2 sequences (the project's own primary, per-sequence experimental evidence); BIOPEP-UWM independently lists both as 'Antioxidative peptide' (database annotation, no per-record assay/reference metadata visible in the scraped table).
biopep_uwm_reconciliation.precedent: Mirrors the already-approved FR1 conflict-resolution policy (Bucket 1): assay-level evidence outranks an undocumented benchmark/database annotation when the two disagree. Applying that same precedent here would argue for RETAINING both in the primary external control, not excluding them.
biopep_uwm_reconciliation.recommendation: Retain both in the primary external-control set per the existing assay-outranks-annotation precedent; flag the contradiction explicitly rather than creating a new sensitivity-only subset. NOT applied unilaterally -- awaiting explicit confirmation.

labeling_rule: These 38 records are inactive under the AnOxPePred FRS/Chelator assay definitions specifically -- NOT a universal claim of proven non-antioxidant activity. Kept entirely separate from the C1/C2/C3 unlabeled training pools at all times.
